market_reaction_thesis: Wall Street consensus expects headline Michigan Sentiment at 70.5, heavily weighted down by equal-sample lower-income inflation fatigue. However, Flashpoint's Affluent Revealed Reality sits at 82.4 (+11.9 pt spread). Because the top 20% drives ~50% of aggregate consumer spending, actual holiday/Q4 retail receipts and premium warehouse comps will crush gloomy street forecasts. Forward trading strategy: Exploit consensus gloom by accumulating high-income winner COST ahead of the print and shorting margin-squeezed mass retailer WMT.

COST.catalyst_timeline: Accumulate T-5 days ahead of Michigan Release; Hold through Q4 earnings print
COST.expected_earnings_comp_bias: Positive Surprise (+140 to +220 bps comp beat)
COST.strategic_thesis: Affluent members (avg HHI $138k) show zero trade-down risk (0.08) and $380+ basket sizes. Membership renewal intent is at 98.2%. Consensus misprices headline doom while Costco registers accelerating traffic.

WMT.catalyst_timeline: Short ahead of Conference Board labor expectations; Hedge against broad retail selloff
WMT.expected_earnings_comp_bias: Negative Margin Compression (Staples mix > 60%, discretionary flat)
WMT.strategic_thesis: Lower-income shoppers (<$60k) are living paycheck to paycheck with maxed credit card lines. While customer traffic holds, extreme substitution into low-margin Great Value items and zero discretionary purchases compress operating margins.

TGT.catalyst_timeline: Market Perform; Avoid directional exposure around sentiment releases
TGT.expected_earnings_comp_bias: In-Line (Flat comps, grocery gains offset by home decor softness)
TGT.strategic_thesis: Target sits in the middle belly ($60k-$120k). Shoppers are maintaining essentials via Target Circle and Good & Gather, but strictly trimming high-margin discretionary home decor and apparel.

pair_trade_recommendation.rationale: Captures Pure K-Shaped Consumer Dispersion with Zero Market Beta Exposure
pair_trade_recommendation.target_catalyst_window: T-5 days before Michigan Prelim to T+10 days post Conference Board
